title: Overview
description:
Esports at UCF is the official Competitive Gaming Sports Club at the University of Central Florida. We bring together competitive players, creators, organizers, and gaming enthusiasts to build a community around esports and gaming.

Our teams compete at the collegiate level across our ten titles, representing UCF in tournaments and leagues throughout the year. But competition is only one part of what we do. We create opportunities for students to develop leadership, production, marketing, broadcasting, event management, and other skills that extend beyond the game.

title: Compete
description: From tactical shooters to Mobas, across our 10 titles we give students the chance to represent their university at the highest levels of play on the collegiate stage.
imageAlt: Members of the Esports at UCF Rocket League team celebrate their 2022 Collegiate Rocket League World Championship victory.

title: Connect
description: We build opportunities for UCF students to connect with each other, professionals, and organizations through our shared experiences, love of gaming, and investment in the future of Esports.Through events like Geek Knight, among our many events and activations throughout the year we bring hundreds of people together.
imageAlt: Top: UCF students at an Evil Geniuses X EUCF Valorant watch party. Bottom: students attend Geek Knight in cosplay and watch live student performances celebrating gaming, anime, and creative communities at UCF.

title: Create
description: We believe in our highly skilled staff members consisting of UCF Students and alumni; creating the content, events, and productions that you see. By investing in our staff through training and opportunities we continue to provide experience for members to thrive in the workforce.
imageAlt: Three promotional graphics created by Esports at UCF students for Valorant and Rocket League events, featuring the Knighto mascot, Evil Geniuses, and original gaming-themed artwork.

title: Give Back
description: Our community believes in striving for excellence online and offline. We understand that our community has given us this platform, we love to demonstrate that gratitude through supporting causes beyond ourselves through charity and community initiatives.
imageAlt: Top: UCF students compete in the 2025 TFT Charity Tournament. Bottom: students cheer for Evil Geniuses at a Valorant watch party with pizza and noise makers.

title: The Dungeon
description:
“The Dungeon” is the home of Esports at UCF, located on the 3rd floor of the student union.

What began as a vision for a dedicated space for collegiate esports, through collaboration between our founders, UCF, and industry partner Monster Energy we established our headquarters.

Today, The Dungeon provides UCF’s competitive esports teams and staff a place to practice, compete, and continue to build the future of Esports at UCF. More than a room this place serves as a physical symbol of how far collegiate esports at UCF has come.
imageAlt: Image of the Dungeon, esports room for EUCF.
